rationale: The assistant correctly identified 4C as a water-supply error, ordered checks sensibly (tap, hose, other taps, then mesh filter) and gave proper isolation steps ('Switch the washer off, unplug it and turn the water tap off', towel underneath). It tracked the customer's evidence accurately, reached the ground-truth cause (clogged inlet mesh after street water works) without recommending any part, and reserved an engineer for the correct contingency. Minor repetition of the same isolation and 'inlet valve ... rather than replacing parts on guesswork' contingency across turns, but it never blocked progress.
